title: GUIDANCE PRAYER
JAMES 1:5
end: The Guided Path — daily prayer for guidance

scenes.a: Some days the honest prayer is simply this: Lord, I do not know what to do.
James chapter one, verse five says, If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
He gives with an open hand, and He does not scold us for needing help again.
Father, we lack wisdom for the choice in front of us. Give us what this moment requires.
Make us willing to obey before we know the answer, and steady us when opinions pull us about.
Let Your wisdom in us be pure, peaceable, gentle, and full of mercy toward everyone it touches.
Type Amen and subscribe to The Guided Path for daily prayers for wisdom and direction.
